tasks.short: Recommend and arrange for diagnostic procedures.

steps.what: Read the findings already recorded for this visit
Recommend the diagnostic procedure with the patient
State the procedure, the reason, and the destination
Copy the stated procedure and reason into the request
Check the request names her procedure and adds no finding
Send the accepted referral to the diagnostic provider

tasks.design: She recommends the procedure in the room, then states the procedure, the clinical reason and the destination on the {OTHER} patient record. A deterministic copy places only those fields into the referral request and does not choose the test or wait for its own check. She checks that the request names her procedure and adds no finding, and only that accepted request is sent to the diagnostic provider. A rejection sends nothing.
tasks.previous_blocker: The request had to be composed by hand in the visit, and a wrong procedure can harm the patient.
tasks.enabler_now: The procedure, reason and destination she states are enough for a field copy into the referral channel that already leaves the clinic.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing the procedure and explaining it to the patient stay with her. A blank reason is not invented.
tasks.human_edge: She is accountable for which test is done. A copied request cannot see the patient.
tasks.altitude: The recommendation in the room stays in her week. Only composing and sending an accepted referral leaves it. She gains no right to skip the choice of procedure.

reach.task: Carry out the imaging named in the accepted referral
reach.learn: Which procedure and clinical reason the chiropractor stated

evidence.claim: Copying a stated procedure, clinical reason and destination into a referral request does not choose the diagnostic test.

assumptions: The patient id is already on the visit in the {OTHER} patient record. She does not re-key it.
Fields she states before the copy are the procedure name, the clinical reason and the diagnostic destination. A blank reason, a blank destination or a blank patient id means no copy.
Try the patient record's own referral message before any custom copy.
The copy places only those stated fields, does not rephrase the reason, does not add a finding, does not suggest a code, and does not wait for its own check.
She does not also type the request. The check compares the procedure and the reason with what she stated. Any change to the copy voids acceptance.
Rejection sends nothing. The send is the arrange step that already leaves the clinic today, through the referral channel to the named diagnostic provider.
A phone booking with no written request is outside these shares.
The request is not uploaded to an external model. There is no ambient recording and no staff-speed view.
A rejected request is dropped in the check, so upkeep hours are zero.
unknowns: Whether this clinic's diagnostic requests already leave as a structured message, or only by a phone call she still makes.
research_questions: How often a visit ends with no outside diagnostic request, so the copy and the send do not fire.

already_counted.description: The check that the request names her procedure and adds no finding, already counted in the review step before the send.

incremental.description: A rejected request is dropped in the check. There is no later rewrite queue, so upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: a year of visits where she rarely sends a patient out for imaging or blood tests, so the request steps rarely fire and the conversation stays. High: a year of weekly referrals whose accepted requests are sent once. She still recommends the procedure and still checks that the request added no finding.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Suggest and apply supports such as straps, tapes, bandages, or braces.

steps.what: Read the findings before any support is applied
Suggest and apply the strap, tape, bandage or brace
Decide whether the support stays on or comes off

tasks.design: She reads the findings, suggests the support, and fits the strap, tape, bandage or brace herself. The fit and the decision to leave it on stay in the room. No request is copied or sent.
tasks.previous_blocker: The fit depends on the limb in front of her, and a wrong support can harm the patient.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing in the fitting became a separable record step that this task already does.
tasks.still_hard: Tension, skin and whether the support stays are judged in the room.
tasks.human_edge: Only she has the limb in her hands. A saved note would not shorten the fitting.
tasks.altitude: Suggesting and fitting the support stay in her week. Nothing leaves it. She gains no new decision right.

reach.task: Continue care when a support is already fitted
reach.learn: Which support was applied and why it stays on

evidence.claim: Fitting a strap, tape, bandage or brace is physical work on the patient, so a saved note would not shorten the fitting.

assumptions: No structured input is required. The findings she reads are already on the visit.
A later line in the patient record about the support is a different task and is outside these shares.
She does not send a request and does not approve her own note.
Upkeep hours are zero because no machine step is added.
unknowns: Whether this clinic records the fitted support inside this task or in a separate record task.
research_questions: How often a support is removed in the same visit, so the decision step is the whole close.

incremental.description: No machine step is added, so upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A year of fittings stays in the room. She still suggests the support, still applies it, and still decides whether it stays.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The recommendation in the room and the fitting of supports stay in her week. Only composing and sending an accepted diagnostic referral leaves it. She gains no new decision right.
skills_to_grow: State the procedure, the clinical reason and the destination before any request is copied.
Reject a request that adds a finding or changes the procedure.
Leave the strap, tape, bandage or brace in her own hands.
role.ambitious_version: The week does not grow. She does not take more visits or fit more supports because a referral can be sent.
